status: provisional exploratory analysis requested by user
primary_measure: RTLX: complete-case unweighted mean of six modified 1-10 dimensions
comparisons: mean of each participant's two animated trials minus their NT trial
V1-V2, V1-V3, V2-V3 within exposed participant pairs
comparison_method: two-sided paired t-tests of mean differences; exact sign tests as direction sensitivity
association_method: OLS RTLX ~ outcome + participant fixed effects + condition + categorical trial position; participant-cluster covariance with small-sample correction and t(G-1) reference; NT uses OLS with position and HC3 covariance
association_outcomes: S: combined detection for animation / no retained press for NT
M: full-or-partial meaning success for animation / condition recognition for NT
multiplicity: Holm across four RTLX contrasts and all 12 prespecified RTLX associations; non-estimable NT Q1 contributes p=1. Separate Holm family for 24 six-dimension contrasts. Sensitivity sign tests adjusted across four RTLX contrasts.
reporting_rule: Conclusive difference/association means Holm p<0.05, not evidence of equivalence when non-significant. Majority means >half estimable tests in each requested group; retain all results in package regardless of significance. No alternative tests selected after seeing p-values.
all_trials: Descriptive overall summary only: it contains the animated and NT subsets, so no independent all-versus-subset tests
uncertainty: 95% individual confidence intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted
limits: Exploratory, small incomplete overlapping animation samples, fixed schedule, workload measured after each trial, no causality, no equivalence margin, Q3 provisional single-coder
ueq_source: canonical aggregate workbook 04a_UEQ, participant IDs matched to included crosswalk; original mapping from existing scoring code; no condition assignment
